legs.note: In development runs an oracle model answers the questions; for a real request the person who asked answers them.

legs.leg: Role agents write the model, the tests, the RTL and the constraints
legs.note: Each role writes only the files it owns, through a path jail in code.
Verilator lint, cocotb tests on Icarus or Verilator, SymbiYosys proofs, coverage and mutation testing.

legs.leg: Vivado synthesis, place and route, and the bitstream
legs.note: The tools build fixed commands; the model never writes Tcl or shell.
Code parses timing, design-rule, clock-crossing, methodology and exception reports into pass or fail.
A failed gate sends the work back to the stage and role that own the failure, within a visit budget.

legs.leg: A yes before a new bitstream is programmed
legs.note: The controller always pauses here and waits for an answer.

legs.leg: Programming the board over JTAG into SRAM
legs.note: Selected by the cable's serial number; volatile memory only.

legs.leg: Tests over the board's UART shell
legs.note: Register reads and writes through a small shell built into every design.

legs.leg: Captures of internal signals with the ILA, in batch
legs.note: Vivado's logic analyser, armed and read by script; the hand-built reference design passes all its captures.

legs.leg: XADC readout of die temperature and core voltage
legs.note: Read over the UART every epoch of a soak; a temperature limit stops the design.
Hours of checked crossings with no one at the board, counted in hardware and read over the UART; a person says yes before a new bitstream is left to soak.

legs.leg: Audio measured at the board's jack
legs.note: A USB audio interface records the output and a program reads frequency, level, distortion and noise; a seeded pin fault that passed simulation and every in-chip check was caught only here.

legs.leg: Instrument captures at the pins (scope, logic analyser, spectrum, video frames)
legs.note: Drivers written and tested on synthetic data; waiting for the instruments to be connected.

legs.leg: A hardware-in-the-loop stage that feeds measurements to the repair loop
legs.note: The stage runs each design's declared checks with tolerances and records measured against expected (flow/hil.py); it is not yet wired into the agent's repair loop.

legs.leg: Wiring an instrument to the board
legs.note: Cables and attenuators are connected by hand, and video cables only with the board off.
The flow refuses any flash write; it programs volatile memory only.

legs.leg: Merging changes and deploying the site
legs.note: The owner merges every change and runs every deploy.
New instruments are bought only when a measurement shows a gap.

The run pauses for a yes before anything is programmed, as it always does. With the owner's yes, the board tests then ran on the agent's files as written.
Act: the bitstream is programmed over JTAG into the board's SRAM, selected by the cable's serial number (2.2 s).
Observe: 3 of 3 tests over the UART shell pass. The ILA trigger the agent wrote needs more comparators than the core has, so Vivado never arms it and the captures fail.
Decide: the board tests fail. Since this run, such a failure goes back to stage 9 with Vivado's error lines, and a dry check before programming catches this kind of trigger.
The instruments were not used in this run: their captures are being measured, and a stage that feeds them to the repair loop is being built.
